title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-024
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA reports and press releases regarding UFO sightings by commercial flight crews in Alaska, containing detailed encounter information.

encounters.summary: Japan Air Lines flight 1628 crew reported an unidentified object accompanying their flight from the Alaska-Canadian border to Fairbanks and Anchorage, observed visually and on radar.
encounters.entity_appearance: Large black chunk, irregular pulsating lights, yellow, amber, green lights, rotating beacon.
encounters.quote: We see irregular pulsating lights just there is a large black chunk just in front of us

encounters.summary: Alaska Airlines flight 53 crew reported an unidentified target on their onboard weather radar moving at high speed near McGrath, Alaska.
encounters.quote: The flight crew reported that the target on their radar moved at a very high rate of speed

encounters.summary: Captain Terauchi of JAL flight 628 reported seeing a group of unusual lights in front of his aircraft.
encounters.quote: reported to the FAA Air Route Traffic Control Center, that he was seeing a group of unusual lights
